resources.string: Pixelates everything on your screen, on top of every app.
Paused. Tap the floating switch to turn back on
Allow \"Display over other apps\" for Pixelated, then press Start again.
Pixelated needs to see the screen to pixelate it.

• A floating switch appears on screen: tap it to turn pixelation on or off, drag it to move it.
• Choose "Entire screen" when Android asks what to share.
• Stop any time from the notification or the status-bar capture chip.
• The status bar, navigation bar and keyboard are not pixelated.
